step2.title: Get a Word
step2.description: The app shows a secret word to the clue-giver only.

step3.title: Give Clues
step3.description:
Describe without saying the word or its parts.
• Use synonyms, hints, or examples.
• No spelling, rhyming, or gestures.

step4.title: Guess Quickly
step4.description:
Teammates guess before time runs out.
• Tap ✅ for correct answers to score points.

step5.title: Pass if Stuck
step5.description: Skip a word if needed (may cost a point).

step6.title: Switch Turns
step6.description: Other team gets the next word.

step7.title: Win the Game
step7.description: Team with the most points when time ends wins!

proTipsContent:
• Be creative with your clues!
• Watch the timer carefully
• Communicate clearly and quickly
• Have fun and don't take it too seriously! 🎉

splash.subtitle:
A fast-paced word guessing game where
creativity and quick thinking win!
